preconditions: The pointer stored at this+0 must be non-null and point to an initialized session object whose vtable slot at 0x58 can return a sender object; otherwise the call returns 10 (blocked).
When a4 (payload) is non-zero it must be an argument accepted by the vtable slot at 0x20 on the sub-object at sender+0x48.
When a4 is zero the sub-object at sender+0x48 must expose a writable byte at offset 0x04.
a8 is treated as a boolean selecting between two sender dispatch paths.
postconditions: Returns 0 on the successful send path; returns 10 when the sender object is unavailable, before any send callee runs.
On the success path sub_586800 is called with (1, 0, a5, a6, a7) and SingleFunctionCallWrapper_6a00 with (a2, a3), in that order, before the a8-selected dispatch.
When a4 is non-zero the payload is forwarded through the sub-object vtable slot at 0x20; when a4 is zero the byte at sender+0x48+0x04 is set to 1.
Finally, if a8 is non-zero VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall(v8) (0x00585380) runs; otherwise sub_585270(v8) runs.

Writes byte value 1 at offset 0x04 of the sub-object at sender+0x48 when a4 is zero.
Calls the vtable slot at 0x20 on the sub-object at sender+0x48 with a4 when a4 is non-zero.
Calls sub_586800 and SingleFunctionCallWrapper_6a00 unconditionally on the success path.
Calls exactly one of 0x00585380 (VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall) or 0x00585270 depending on a8.
